fichas.title: Retail regulations for sales areas, fire compartments, exits and escape routes
fichas.summary: Retail regulations apply to outlets with a total area of more than 2,000 m², including sales areas, shop passages and building elements. The page defines sales areas and shop passages; limits sales-area floor levels; specifies fire-compartment sizes; and sets requirements for emergency stairways, exits, escape routes and emergency corridors.

dimensions.label: Threshold for retail regulations
dimensions.context: Total area of sales areas and shop passages, including building elements; regulations apply above this area.

dimensions.label: Minimum shop-passage width
dimensions.context: Covered routes adjacent to sales areas that contain customer traffic.
dimensions.ocr_raw: They must be at least 5 m wide.

dimensions.label: Maximum sales-area level above ground
dimensions.context: Maximum permitted height above ground level, except for catering establishments.
dimensions.ocr_raw: floor level >22 m above ground level

dimensions.label: Maximum sales-area level below ground
dimensions.context: Maximum permitted depth below ground level, except for catering establishments.
dimensions.ocr_raw: >5 m below ground level

dimensions.label: Fire-compartment sales area with sprinklers, upper floor
dimensions.context: Maximum area shown for an upper-floor sales area with a sprinkler system.
dimensions.ocr_raw: Sales area ≤10,000 m2 on upper floor

dimensions.label: Fire-compartment sales area with sprinklers, upper floor
dimensions.context: Maximum area shown for an upper-floor sales area with a sprinkler system.
dimensions.ocr_raw: Sales area ≤ 5,000 m2 on upper floor

dimensions.label: Fire-compartment sales area without sprinklers, ground floor
dimensions.context: Maximum area shown for a ground-floor sales area without a sprinkler system.
dimensions.ocr_raw: Sales area ≤ 3,000 m2 on ground floor

dimensions.label: Fire-compartment sales area without sprinklers, upper floors
dimensions.context: Maximum area shown for an upper-floor sales area, up to the third floor, without a sprinkler system.
dimensions.ocr_raw: Sales area ≤1,500 m2 on upper floor up to max 3rd floor

dimensions.label: Fire-compartment area, ground-floor sales outlet with sprinklers
dimensions.context: Permissible fire-compartment area per floor in a ground-floor sales outlet with sprinklers.
dimensions.ocr_raw: ground floor sales outlets 10,000 m2

dimensions.label: Fire-compartment area, ground-floor sales outlet without sprinklers
dimensions.context: Permissible fire-compartment area per floor in a ground-floor sales outlet without sprinklers.
dimensions.ocr_raw: ground floor sales outlets 5,000 m2

dimensions.label: Fire-compartment area, other sales outlets with sprinklers
dimensions.context: Permissible fire-compartment area per floor in other sales outlets with sprinklers.
dimensions.ocr_raw: other sales outlets 5,000 m2

dimensions.label: Fire-compartment area, other sales outlets without sprinklers
dimensions.context: Permissible fire-compartment area per floor in other sales outlets without sprinklers; the printed footnote gives an exception for certain multi-floor layouts.
dimensions.ocr_raw: other sales outlets 1,500 m2 ' *if the sales areas extend over more than three floors and the total area of all floors within a fire compartment is not more than 3,000 m2

dimensions.label: Fire-compartment area under footnote exception
dimensions.context: Footnote condition: total area of all floors within a fire compartment.
dimensions.ocr_raw: the total area of all floors within a fire compartment is not more than 3,000 m2

dimensions.label: Emergency stairway width
dimensions.context: Customer emergency stairways; the stated width is bounded by a minimum and maximum.
dimensions.ocr_raw: at least 2.0 m wide and may not exceed a width of 2.5 m

dimensions.label: Emergency stairway width for smaller sales areas
dimensions.context: Adequate width when the stairway serves sales areas under 500 m² in total.
dimensions.ocr_raw: A width of 1.25 m is adequate if the stairway is provided for sales areas <500 m2 in total

dimensions.label: Minimum exits per sales area, occupied room or shop passage
dimensions.context: Minimum number of exits leading to the open air or into an emergency stairway; one exit is sufficient for sales areas under 100 m² in total.
dimensions.ocr_raw: must have a min. 2 exits leading to the open air or into an emergency stairway. One exit is sufficient for sales areas <100 m2 in total

dimensions.label: Sales-area threshold for one-exit allowance
dimensions.context: One exit is sufficient when the total sales area is below this threshold.
dimensions.ocr_raw: One exit is sufficient for sales areas <100 m2 in total

dimensions.label: Exit width per sales-area area
dimensions.context: Width of exits from a floor to the open air or an emergency stairway, calculated per sales-area area.
dimensions.ocr_raw: must have a width of 30 cm per 100 m2 of sales area

dimensions.label: Minimum exit width
dimensions.context: General minimum exit width; for exits from sales areas under 500 m², a width of 1 m is sufficient.
dimensions.ocr_raw: and be min. 2 m wide, but for exits from sales areas <500 m2, a width of 1 m is sufficient

dimensions.label: Exit width for sales areas under 500 m²
dimensions.context: Sufficient exit width for exits from sales areas under 500 m².
dimensions.ocr_raw: for exits from sales areas <500 m2, a width of 1 m is sufficient

dimensions.label: Sales-area threshold for reduced exit width
dimensions.context: Sales-area threshold below which a 1 m exit width is sufficient.
dimensions.ocr_raw: for exits from sales areas <500 m2

dimensions.label: Minimum escape routes
dimensions.context: Minimum routes for each sales area, occupied area and shop passage; routes should be on the same floor and, if possible, lead in opposite directions.
dimensions.ocr_raw: min. two escape routes must be provided on the same floor, if possible going in opposite directions

dimensions.label: Maximum escape-route access distance in sales areas
dimensions.context: Distance from every point in a sales area to an escape route.
dimensions.ocr_raw: within a distance of 25 m from every point of a sales area

dimensions.label: Maximum escape-route access distance in other areas or shop passages
dimensions.context: Distance from every point in other areas or shop passages to an escape route.
dimensions.ocr_raw: or 35 m for other areas or shop passages

dimensions.label: Maximum distance to a main entrance or shop passage
dimensions.context: Linear distance from every point in a sales area.
dimensions.ocr_raw: within 10 m (linear distance) of every point in a sales area

dimensions.label: Minimum emergency-corridor width
dimensions.context: Customer emergency corridors.
dimensions.ocr_raw: For customers these must be at least 2 m wide.

dimensions.label: Emergency-corridor width for smaller sales areas
dimensions.context: Sufficient width when corridors are intended for sales areas under 500 m².
dimensions.ocr_raw: A width of 1.40 m is sufficient if corridors are intended for sales areas <500 m2

dimensions.label: Sales-area threshold for reduced emergency-corridor width
dimensions.context: Sales-area threshold below which a 1.40 m corridor width is sufficient.
dimensions.ocr_raw: if corridors are intended for sales areas <500 m2
